verdict.rationale: Cerebras ships official Python and Node/TypeScript SDKs (pip install cerebras_cloud_sdk, cerebras-cloud-sdk-node on GitHub) plus OpenAI-compatible client support, with docs covering streaming, tool calling, structured outputs, and batch APIs—clearly agentic-workflow-friendly. Community evidence confirms real-world SDK/agent integration (coding agents, Cursor support) though with some rough edges like rate-limit friction. Missing for 10: independent quality assessment of SDK docs/API reference completeness and broader language SDK coverage beyond Python/Node.
